title: Maestro Asset Manifest
description: The generation spec for every visual asset the Game IR references by id. The IR carries only ids (background, sprite, icon, map); this manifest owns everything needed to PRODUCE the image: prompts, dimensions, animations, style anchors. One id space shared with the IR — every asset id the IR references must exist here. Design rationale lives in game_ir_decisions.md.

style.description: Optional global style applied to every asset's prompt (art direction the whole game shares).

prompt.description: Style suffix mixed into every generation, e.g. 'painterly noir, muted palette'.

id.description: Matches the id the IR references (background/sprite/icon/map).

kind.description: What slot this fills + its generation defaults.

prompt.description: Positive generation prompt for the image.

width.description: Override default size for the kind.

transparent.description: Request an alpha background (sprites, portraits, item icons).

style_ref.description: Optional asset id to anchor style/character consistency against.

animations.description: Optional animation states. Omit for a still image.

name.description: State name, e.g. idle / walk / talk / attack.

fps.description: Playback rate; defaults to a per-kind value.

loop.description: Whether the state loops (idle/walk) or plays once (attack).
